description: This file defines the TwigTest class, which represents a template test in the Twig templating engine. It extends AbstractTwigCallable and manages test-specific options and behaviors.

classes.name: TwigTest
classes.description: A class representing a template test in Twig, capable of handling the test's callable, options, and behavior.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TwigTest instance with a name, optional callable, and options.

methods.name: needsCharset
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need charset information.

methods.name: needsEnvironment
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need the environment context.

methods.name: needsContext
methods.description: Indicates that this test does not need the current context.

methods.name: hasOneMandatoryArgument
methods.description: Returns whether the test has one mandatory argument based on options.

methods.name: getMinimalNumberOfRequiredArguments
methods.description: Returns the minimal number of arguments required, adding one to the parent's value.
